messages:
marcel (product): @here Heads-up: Private v3.1 rollout planned for 2026-12-09 (Wave-1). This release introduces per-resource "export labels" (customers can mark specific datasets as non-exportable or restricted), a new Audit-Handoff API for controlled reviewer access, and an Export Review Queue for manual approvals. Internal release doc: https://go/internal/private-v3-1-export-labels (internal). Please run the preflight and complete readiness checks by Tue EOD.

taylor (support): Quick Q — how does the export label differ from the existing export_allowed flag?

marcel (product): Good Q. export_allowed is a binary tenant-level gate. Export labels operate at the dataset/object level (e.g., model-store/my-model:v1 -> label=restricted). Labels flow into the UI and the CLI and are enforced by the agent during bundle creation. Customers can request an override via the Export Review Queue which records approval metadata.

anya (security): Important: any override must be accompanied by a consent token signed by the customer's admin and a rationale. For restricted jurisdictions, overrides are disabled unless Legal grants an exception. We'll publish the token format and signing example.

sam (legal): We'll provide a short Export Exception addendum template that customers must sign to allow labeled-restricted exports. No pricing change, but exceptions require review. I'll upload the template and a one-click approval checklist for low-risk partners.

opsbot: rollout-scheduler: Draft rollout created for wave-1: start=3520030000 window=10800 owner=@marcel id=rollout-352003 :calendar:

yoav (eng-runtime): Runtime notes: agent enforces labels at bundle-creation time and injects label metadata into the audit bundle. New endpoints: 
```
# create export request (admin)
curl -X POST https://private-admin.internal/customers/CUSTID/export-requests \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"since":"2026-11-01","labels":["public","restricted"],"reason":"audit review"}'

# admin checks status
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://private-admin.internal/export-requests/REQID | jq .status
```
If labels include "restricted" and no valid consent token present, request will be queued for manual review. Agent preflight snippet for self-hosters: 
```
# preflight check for export label enforcement
docker run --rm redwood/private-agent:3.1 preflight --customer-id=CUST123 --check-export-labels
```
We added a guard: exports that attempt to include >10GB of restricted-labeled objects trigger an automatic hold for human review.

anya (security): We'll also require the consent token to be PKI-signed and include a SHA256 fingerprint of the export bundle to be recorded at approval time. Security will surface a sample token generator for customers.

taylor (support): I'll add readiness columns: export_labels_configured, export_exception_requested, consent_token_present, review_contact. We'll prep a customer checklist and canned email templates.

sam (legal): Action: uploading Export Exception addendum and approval flow doc to the drive by EOD.

marcel (product): Monitoring/alerts: create monitors for export_request.status==held > 30m and export_attempts.denied_by_label > 5/hour/customer. Also capture review-audit events for retention. Yoav, can you add those?

yoav (eng-runtime): Yep. I'll add the two monitors and an event that includes approver, timestamp, and token fingerprint. Also note: enabling unredacted restricted exports requires agent restart to rotate keys used for audit signing. We'll document this in the runbook.

opsbot: notify: policy-update: export-labels added to product-policy registry id=policy-exports-2026 :bookmark_tabs:

marcel (product): Summary action items: Legal - upload addendum & approval flow (@sam); Security - publish token format & sample generator (@anya); Support - add readiness columns + customer templates (@taylor); Eng - add preflight commands to runbook, implement monitors, and document restart behavior (@yoav). React with :white_check_mark: when your item is done. We'll hold GA if any critical blockers remain by Tue 23:59 UTC. Thanks all! :rocket:
